name: Grizzlegom
description: Minotaur commander who mercy kills Agnate and kills Dralnu.

description_citations.text: "Planeshift (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dralnu infects Agnate with plague; Agnate asks Grizzlegom to kill him and take command; Grizzlegom destroys Dralnu's minions.
timeline.quote: Agnate asked Grizzlegom to kill him and take command of his armies

citation.text: "Agnate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Coalition forces fight their way to the Stronghold and battle Crovax's Phyrexian soldiers.
timeline.quote: fight their way to the Stronghold, where they battle Crovax's Phyrexian soldiers

citation.text: "Apocalypse", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri, Lin Sivvi and Grizzlegom search for a backdoor into the Stronghold and meet dwarves planning to blast a tunnel.
timeline.quote: try to find a backdoor into the Stronghold

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The cloud kills the minotaur and metathran armies on Urborg except a small group saved by Lord Windgrace.
timeline.quote: brought to Hurloon by Lord Windgrace just in time

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Astor and Eladamri arrive in Urborg to join the metathran army under Grizzlegom.
timeline.quote: Astor arrived alongside Eladamri in the swamps to unite with the metathran army.

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri and Grizzlegom attack the Stronghold but are held at the Portcullis, then ally with stone dwarves who tunnel in and destroy the gate from behind.
timeline.quote: snuck up behind Portcullis, defeated the outflanked Phyrexians, and destroyed the gate before raiding the Stronghold

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agnate learns his illness was caused by Dralnu, who wants his army; Agnate signs his forces to Grizzlegom, who mercy kills him and then kills Dralnu.
timeline.quote: who mercy kills the metathran commander and then kills Dralnu.
